description_en: Adds or removes a policy template to or from My Policies in the task center
description_zh: 添加/删除某个策略模版到任务中心-我的策略中
name: ModifySoarStrategySubscribe

parameters.help_en:
The policy ID.
Call the [DescribeSoarStrategies](~~DescribeSoarStrategies~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
策略ID。
调用[DescribeSoarStrategies](~~DescribeSoarStrategies~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: strategy_id

parameters.help_en:
The add or remove status. Valid values:
true: adds the policy template to My Policies
false: removes the policy template from My Policies
parameters.help_zh:
添加/删除状态。取值：
true：添加到我的策略
false：从我的策略删除
parameters.name: subscribe_status
